description:
Name: [Chesed](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/chesed.png:150:150)
Known Locations: The Briah Dimension, entered through an Eye of Chesed

Behavior: Uses a variety of energy based attacks ignoring target resistence. Several monoliths around it and power large attacks if not deactivated through damaging. Cannot be harmed directly and must have its own lightning strikes reflected by a Reflector powered through breaking energized crystals.
